crew.name: Browser Game Delivery Crew
crew.purpose: Create, verify, and package a small standalone browser game for a user ask.

roles.name: Game Designer
roles.accountability: Define the playable experience before implementation.
roles.boundary: Owns game rules, player loop, controls, difficulty curve, and acceptance criteria. Does not implement code or package files.
acceptance_checks: The game has a clear start, play, fail, and restart loop.
Controls and scoring are understandable without extra setup.
Scope fits a small standalone browser deliverable.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Prioritize shooting loop, enemy waves, lives, scoring, and replay.

roles.name: Gameplay Engineer
roles.boundary: Owns movement, shooting, enemies, collision, score, lives, power-ups, and game state. Does not own visual styling or final packaging.
acceptance_checks: Core mechanics are implemented in reusable game logic.
Collision, scoring, life loss, and power-ups are testable.
Game state can start, play, and end predictably.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Prioritize player movement, firing, enemies, collision, scoring, and lives.

roles.name: Rendering Engineer
roles.accountability: Present the game clearly in the browser.
roles.boundary: Owns canvas drawing, animation loop, HUD synchronization, responsive layout, and touch controls. Does not own gameplay rules or test assertions.
acceptance_checks: The first screen renders clearly in a browser.
Keyboard and touch controls are available.
Layout fits desktop and mobile widths without overlap.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Prioritize aircraft, enemies, bullets, HUD, and responsive canvas presentation.

roles.name: QA Analyst
roles.boundary: Owns test cases, test execution, smoke checks, and defect reports. Does not alter product scope.
acceptance_checks: Browser smoke check renders the game page when a local browser is available.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Prioritize collision, scoring, life loss, power-up, static, and browser smoke tests.

roles.name: Delivery Operator
roles.boundary: Owns README, zip contents, archive creation, and final handoff. Does not change source conclusions after testing.
acceptance_checks: The zip contains all playable files and tests.
The user can open `index.html` after extraction.
The final response includes the package path and test status.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Prioritize local package contents, archive creation, and handoff clarity.
